decisions.quote: • The findings of a single small‐scale study previously indicated that such patients’ needs for information are not always fully met and pain control is inadequate.• This small‐scale study was replicated to produce broadly similar findings in a second hospital 2 years later.
decisions.reason: The available source text (Fox, Gould, Davies, & Owen, 1999, 'Patients’ experiences of having an underwater seal chest drain: a replication study') contains only the title, author list, and abstract. While the abstract explicitly states that a previous single small-scale study on chest drain patients' information needs and pain control was empirically replicated in a second hospital two years later with broadly similar findings, the abstract gives no author names, year, title, or DOI for that prior study. Without full text or references in the primary source, it cannot be verified from source evidence alone whether the replicated study is the shipped row 2433 (Owen & Gould, 1997, 'Underwater seal chest drains: the patient's experience', DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2702.1997.tb00307.x) or a different unshipped report.
